Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)

Required findings: Prior adjacent-level lumbar fusion was performed at least 6 months prior
Criteria have been met in the applicable procedure-specific section: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression or CMM-609.5: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) without Decompression

Non-Indications: Lumbar fusion for adjacent segment disease performed less than 6 months after the prior adjacent-level lumbar fusion
Cases where the criteria for the applicable procedure-specific section (CMM-609.4 or CMM-609.5) have not been met
Important criteria & exceptions: The policy requires that ALL criteria be met for medical necessity

Verification of medical necessity depends on meeting the specific criteria outlined in either CMM-609.4 (Lumbar Fusion with Decompression) or CMM-609.5 (Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) without Decompression)
Documentation required: Documentation verifying the date of the prior adjacent-level lumbar fusion to confirm at least 6 months have elapsed
Documentation demonstrating that criteria for CMM-609.4 (Lumbar Fusion with Decompression) or CMM-609.5 (Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) without Decompression) have been met
